findings.title: Session timestamp incorrectly reset on page load
findings.evidence: localStorage.setItem('lastActivity', Date.now().toString()) is called when restoring a valid session, resetting the inactivity timer
findings.consequence: Users receive a fresh 60-second session window on every page reload, even after 59 seconds of inactivity. The 1-minute inactivity requirement is violated.
findings.correction: Remove line 42 that updates lastActivity on session restoration. The timestamp should only be updated on actual user interaction via updateLastActivity() called by InactivityLogout.
